review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T020. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. The equivalence-principle value is taken from the published LLR analysis.

question: How large can the shared route-B time constant tau_beta be, given the Earth-Moon equivalence-principle result from lunar laser ranging?

output.domain: Earth-Moon system toward the Sun, psi range much longer than 1 AU
output.accuracy: Gaussian 2 sigma on the published Delta, used on the predicted side.

model.assumptions: Dissipation sources psi with a reciprocal coupling (AI proposal); a = 0 in the primary bound.
model.approximation: Bodies as points; P = absorbed sunlight plus internal heat; Sun P = luminosity.
model.initial_boundary: Static fields, range much longer than 1 AU.
model.parameters: No fitting; tau_beta_max from the published Delta.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Published abstract values seen before drafting (SEEN_SUMMARY), declared in Test Card T020.

system_partition.boundary: Earth-Moon-Sun system; published LLR solution used only.

systems.state: Earth and Moon in orbit around the Sun

couplings.map: Round-trip laser time to lunar retroreflectors
Radiation pressure and thermal effects handled upstream

observables.readout_map: Published Delta and sigma; read only

observation.source_state: Sun as source of gravity and of the route-B field.

components.reason: Bodies and dissipation rates as fixed in the card.

tau_beta_max = sqrt((2 sigma - Delta)/(x_S (x_M - x_E))); outcome rule fixed in T020.

error_budget.approximation: P definitions are AI choices; changing albedo by 0.05 changes x_E, x_M by about 6 percent.
error_budget.measurement: Published sigma; formal or realistic not checked.
error_budget.systematic: Cross term with the mass portal can loosen the bound to 5.2e15 s.
error_budget.omissions: Other planets and laboratory tests not used.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T020.

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T020 comparison only; the evidence level is set in docs/standard. UET-distinct coupling (route B, AI proposal).
next_action: Laboratory Cavendish test with heated masses would improve the bound about 1e4 times.
